head: bda5b84c
subject: mpfb-peds-patient-child.glb
question: can a high-to-low cage bake run on a multi-mesh MPFB humanoid at all

decimation.primsWithUV: 16 of 17 in BOTH high and low

bake.error: No active UV layer found in the object "LOW"

finding: NOT a contamination result. hl_bake.py joins every imported mesh into ONE object (hl_bake.py:12-18). A humanoid is 10 meshes; the join leaves no ACTIVE UV layer, so the bake refuses before casting a ray. The asset has UVs and the decimation preserves them.
whatThisSettles: humanoids DO decimate: 61,068 -> 19,497 with UVs intact
the reference bake script cannot bake a multi-mesh subject as written
whatThisDoesNotSettle: whether a humanoid cage bake is contaminated - no ray was cast
whether per-mesh baking works, which is the obvious next move and was not tried
claimScope: one subject, one decimation ratio, one bake attempt at 512 on 2026-08-26.
notEvidenceFor: any verdict on cage-bake contamination for humanoids; the run did not reach the point where contamination could occur.
